_doc: Printers (mm), source docs/research/design-checks.md. A part's process.printer in part_settings names the entry. build_volume_mm: main nozzle; build_volume_both_nozzles_mm: both nozzles used (support from the second nozzle). nozzles_mm: nozzle sizes offered. by_nozzle: printer process defaults per nozzle (layer height, line width) used when a part sets none; they are Bambu Studio's 'Standard' system process values per nozzle (layer = half the nozzle, line = nozzle + 0.02 mm), confirmed against the installed Bambu Studio 2.8.2 X2D 'Standard' process profiles (0.4: 0.20 / 0.42 mm, 0.6: 0.30 / 0.62 mm). hole_offset_mm: printed hole diameter minus CAD diameter for vertical holes (negative = holes print small), measured on a test coupon; null = not measured yet (the hole check then reports CAD sizes only). bambu_studio: the slicer the slicer check runs headless (binary, system profile folder, the system profile names per nozzle, bed type, overrides applied to the process profile; support on so its amount is measured).

Bambu X2D.note: main (left, direct-drive) nozzle 256 x 256 x 260; with the second nozzle 235.5 x 256 x 256
